items.name: Corrupted Touch
items.text: A corrupted nosoi's Strikes deal 1d6 void damage to living creatures. A creature critically hit by a corrupted nosoi's Strike must attempt a DC 18 Fortitude save save or become Drained 1 (Drained 2 on a critical failure) as rot spreads through their flesh.

items.name: Haunting Melody
items.text:
The nosoi croons "the Lord slumbers below, you're nothing but his dreams, and when the lord awakes, you'll know the end of things!". Each living or undead creature within a 60-foot emanation must attempt a DC 18 Will save save. The effect lasts for 1 round, but a nosoi can use this ability again on subsequent rounds to extend the duration by 1 round for all affected creatures. A creature that succeeds at any save is temporarily immune for 24 hours. Despite being a mental effect, this ability affects mindless undead. Psychopomps are immune to this ability.

---

Failure The creature is Fascinated.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature must spend each of its actions on its turn to move closer to the nosoi as expediently as possible while avoiding obvious dangers. If a Fascinated creature is adjacent to the nosoi, it stays still and doesn't act. If the creature is attacked, the fascination ends.
